title: the understudy
premise: You've been the understudy for the lead for two years. Tonight the lead has lost her voice an hour before curtain, and she's begging you not to tell the director.
setting: Backstage at a small, proud theatre in a cold northern city, opening night of the winter season.
tone: backstage chaos with real heartbreak underneath

self.description: You know every line, every mark, and every time she's been late.
self.want: To finally go on, and to deserve it.
self.avoids: Being the person who took it from her.

cast.name: Noor
cast.description: Brilliant, proud and frightened. This role is her comeback.
cast.want: To get through tonight somehow, and keep the part.
cast.avoids: Admitting she's been sick for a week.
cast.closeness: you came up through drama school together
cast.tension: she got the part you both auditioned for

cast.name: Teodor
cast.description: Exacting, sentimental about the theatre, ruthless about the show.
cast.want: A perfect opening night for the critics.
cast.avoids: Hearing about problems after it's too late to fix them.
cast.tension: he has never once called you by your name

opening.title: The casting
opening.description: Two years ago Noor got the lead. You got the understudy and a hug.

opening.title: The cough
opening.description: All week Noor has been drinking honey and skipping notes.

opening.title: Fifty-eight minutes
opening.description: In the dressing room Noor whispers that she can't sing. "Please don't tell him."

background: A critic Noor once dated is in the second row tonight.
You've rehearsed her part alone in your kitchen hundreds of times.
